verdict.rationale: The docs touch only on execution scope. Skills can bundle executable scripts (docs-52), run in the API's code execution environment (docs-10), and are governed by controls over who or what can invoke them, including disabling bundled skills (docs-34, docs-63, docs-19). Nothing in the pack describes a trust or vetting model for third-party or marketplace skills, or any telemetry or data-collection policy. missing for 10: a documented trust model for third-party/marketplace skills, telemetry/data-collection disclosure, a consolidated security-posture document for skill execution (sandbox boundaries, permissions), independent corroboration
